narrative: On the almanack. The February and March leaves of a penny almanac on the parlour table, under one candle. Two marks in his hand, and no third. John's sleeve at the edge of the board.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Stood at the table while the marks went in. His face is not on the page.
